answers.core: Yes, it's on CharacterBody2D and some of the implementations would even override move_and_collide. Also, they need to be able to set `on_floor` which is not accessible in GD script.
answers.workaround:
I already described a workaround in my step 3.

Another workaround is to track your own is_on_floor variable, still using the custom raycast/last move_and_collide call. But then you're basically writing your custom character collider, reducing the advantage of CharacterBody2D (except you have a bonus method move_and_slide).

title: CharacterBody2D: add a method to move and snap (not slide), but still update is_on_floor() result
